sdk.errorMessage: This repository builds with the .NET SDK 10.0.114 exactly (global.json). Install it per user or machine-wide; for a per-user install, run the build from a PowerShell that has called Initialize-BuildEnvironment from tools\Initialize-BuildEnvironment.ps1, or set DOTNET_MSBUILD_SDK_RESOLVER_CLI_DIR to the folder that holds that dotnet.exe and put the folder first in PATH. See README.md, Building.
